# Let's search for all remaining songs and collect their release dates.
songs_to_fix = [
    "Lost in the Embrace of Night",
    "Lonely Skies",
    "Caught in a Web of Lies",
    "On the Border of Reality",
    "A Love That Never Was",
    "Astral Serenity",
    "Between Reality and Reverie",
    "Strangers Again",
    "The Mirage of a Perfect Life",
    "Wilted Roses on the Vine",
    "When All Words Fail Us",
    "Final Echo"
]

release_months = {}
for song_title in songs_to_fix:
    # Search with title and maybe artist? We'll just use title for now.
    result = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=song_title, access_token=spotify_token, page_limit=5)
    # Find exact match
    found = None
    for song in result:
        if song['title'].lower() == song_title.lower():
            found = song
            break
    if found:
        release_date = found['release_date']  # e.g., "2021-03-23T13:53:26"
        # Extract year and month
        year = release_date[:4]
        month = release_date[5:7]
        release_months[song_title] = f"{month}/{year}"
        print(f"{song_title}: {release_months[song_title]}")
    else:
        print(f"NOT FOUND: {song_title}")
